device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 0B000A00 (bootloader version "M3601A 1.1.3", 8 MB SPI flash, 128 MB DDR2/DDR3 M3606 / C3603 platform, stb_board_type = 6)
device.soc: ALi M3601A / M3606 / C3603 (chip word 0x3603, SDK sys_ic_get_chip_id=0x10047, rev=0x20001; seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200)
device.demod: internal ALi S3501 DVB-S2 (NIM_S3501_0 at I2C 0x33)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko (1.7.10 EMU)
source.note: Archive AMIKO_SHD-8110_1.7.10_emu.zip from the Amiko/Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, run_dump_shd8110_app_starts.py, run_dump_shd8110_capture_screen.py): the "M3601A 1.1.3" bootloader prints "APP  init ok" and "---HC164 attach OK--", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E9103C, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA7000200 and maincode(AV) ("0B000A001710") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores.  The application prints "stb_tuner_type = 1, stb_board_type =6." and "sys_ic_get_chip_id=0x10047    sys_ic_get_rev_id =0x20001", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands, 30 colours).

desc: Amiko SHD-8110 (System ID 0B000A00) firmware v1.7.10 EMU (2016-10-26) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3601A / M3606 (C3603) Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.
Uses a dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" architecture with SEE running at 0xA7000200, an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and a 44-entry 0x44xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
